title: Public-only one-sided concrete-claim groundedness surface audit
scope: DEV-only evaluator-validity diagnostic; no model generation
inputs_allowed: agent-input cases used by the public runner
frozen split manifest for DEV/LOCKED_TEST boundary enforcement

frozen_checks.visible_case_selection: first agent-input case per asset/group, matching the runner

concrete_id_provenance.check: non-placeholder asset/analysis/model/case/ticket-style identifiers and UUIDs mentioned in free text must occur in the selected visible case

public_endpoint_provenance.check: explicit METHOD+path mentions must normalize to a public tool signature

unit_numeric_provenance.check: unit-bearing numeric claims in a narrow industrial unit allowlist must have both the numeric literal and unit represented in the selected visible case
unit_numeric_provenance.interpretation: one-sided heuristic; violations are actionable, absence of violations is not proof of semantic entailment

self_attested_trace.interpretation: supporting structural signal only, never accepted as proof by itself

interpretation.any_concrete_provenance_violation: groundedness validity gate remains blocked and concrete unsupported-claim surface is demonstrated
interpretation.zero_concrete_provenance_violations: general semantic groundedness remains UNMEASURED; zero findings cannot authorize VALIDATION
